project.title: WriteAnBlog
project.subtitle: Community-Driven Editorial & Blogging Platform

screenshots.caption: Landing page highlighting featured stories and daily historical deep dives
Chronological article feed with real-time engagement, reading metrics, and dark mode tag taxonomy
Immersive long-form article reading view with typography-first historical deep dive
Author publishing suite & rich-text editor with cover image uploader and draft manager
Community member onboarding and author account creation portal

project.overview: WriteAnBlog is a full-featured, content-first publishing and editorial platform engineered for both daily staff editorials and open community storytelling. It features automated daily publication feeds, tag discovery architectures, reading time estimators, interactive engagement metrics, and a curated newsletter digest pipeline.

key_features.name: Curated Featured Showcase
key_features.description: Dynamic hero highlight system tailored for daily marquee essays and long-form investigative pieces.

key_features.name: Chronological Editorial Stream
key_features.description: Infinite-scrolling community and staff feed with automated read-time calculations and publication timestamps.

key_features.name: Taxonomy & Tag Engine
key_features.description: Granular multi-tag categorization allowing readers to filter between history, science, aviation, and engineering.

key_features.name: Community & Author Profiles
key_features.description: Decoupled author model supporting institutional editorial boards as well as independent guest contributors.

key_features.name: Social Signals & Analytics
key_features.description: Low-latency micro-interactions tracking article claps, bookmark counts, and comment threads.

key_features.name: Automated Weekly Digest
key_features.description: Integrated newsletter subscription modal for sending weekly top-performing editorial essays.
